title: Are your cottages child friendly? | Blaco Hill Farm Cottages

post.title: Are your cottages child friendly?
post.html: Yes, growing up at Blaco and now having children of our own we know how important this is. Stair gates, Ikea highchairs and travel cots can all be requested free of charge and we have plenty of open space to run around, with a woodland children play area and indoor games room with a selection of toys and games for all ages.
